scenarios.prompt: The user is attending a crowded standing-room indie concert from 7 p.m. to midnight and wants the required racer jacket to be the single visual headline. Build outfits that survive four hours of standing and movement, manage the jacket's volume, and still look intentional if the jacket comes off. Avoid stacking unrelated graphics or pretending the wardrobe contains shoes.
